# Rename ledger (tools/rename.py, T-27002): kind scope old new key note, appended by `rename.py apply`.
# Do not edit by hand; `rename.py replay` applies it to any tree, `rename.py check` keeps old names out.
type EVENT EvEnt SpotLinePair - pair of words (a, b) used by the line-drawing helper
type EVENT EventBirthday4 SpotBirthdayBits - month (4 bits) and day (5 bits) of a birthday word; core BirthdayBits
type EVENT EventChoice3 SpotResultTriple - three result bytes for one variant and choice
type EVENT EventEffectTables SpotDevelopmentEffectView - partial dev GameState view for the particle code: byte flags at +0x1031 and 58 words at +0x13A8
type EVENT EventFrameCounter SpotFrameCounter - unsigned view of the step timer word
type EVENT EventGirlRec34 SpotLegacyGirlRecord - 0x34-byte legacy girl record: tokimeki, affection and syoushin with their fraction halves, flags, birthday word and 0x20 event counters; core calls the shared Rec34 LegacyGirlRecord
type EVENT EventGirlRec34Fix SpotLegacyGirlRecordFixed - 16.16 word view of the first three legacy record fields
type EVENT EventMovieState SpotDevelopmentStepView - view of the dev step bookkeeping at D_800B1AF0: step timer word, mode, stage, step, substep
type EVENT EventMovieWork SpotRideMovieWork - control halfwords and bytes of the ride movies at D_800F1990
type EVENT EventMuseumChoices15 SpotMuseumChoiceTable - 5 exhibit choices of result triples
type EVENT EventPlaceChoices18 SpotShopChoiceTable - 3 choices x 2 variants of result triples (shopping street)
type EVENT EventRec24 SpotSpriteQuad - signed halfword views of sprite quad (Rec24, core SpriteQuad) fields
type EVENT EventRecordFlags SpotLegacyGirlFlagBits - bit view of the legacy record flag word (bit 0, bit 1 of the word)
type EVENT EventResultRow6 SpotResultCells - three signed halfword result/reaction cells
type EVENT EventRideChoices36 SpotRideChoiceTable - 6 rides x 2 variants of result triples
type EVENT EventStateFixView SpotDevelopmentStateFixed - dev GameState view that reads the girl records as 16.16 fixed-point words
type EVENT EventStateGirlView SpotDevelopmentStateGirls - second dev GameState view with the player looks value, last place, last outcomes, frame count, step timer and mode (same dev layout)
type EVENT EventStateView SpotDevelopmentState - dev-build GameState view at D_800B0860 (min size 0x1298): calendar bytes, girls array, event flags, current girl, stage and step at the dev offsets; layout differs from the shipped GameState
type EVENT EventTable2D6 SpotPlaceNameTable - 22 place name records of 33 bytes
type EVENT EventTableE7 SpotPlaceAffinityTable - HYPOTHESIS: type used for 11 heroines x 21 places of preference values; body indexes it as table[girl][place]
type EVENT EventTransitionState SpotDevelopmentStepViewShort - shorter view of the same bookkeeping used by the ride movie fade code
type EVENT U16x21 SpotPlaceHalfwords - 21 halfwords, one per place
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecord unk_00 tokimeki_fraction - fraction half of the 16.16 word at +0 (shipped GirlRecord)
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecord unk_02 tokimeki - tokimeki value
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecord unk_04 affection_fraction - fraction half of the word at +4
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecord unk_06 affection - affection value
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecord unk_08 syoushin_fraction - fraction half of the 16.16 word at +8 (core spelling: syoushin_fraction)
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecord unk_0A syoushin - HYPOTHESIS: game interpretation unknown; retain core's developer term for the halfword at +0xA; in this build the scene steps subtract 10 to 28 after good outcomes and add 10 to 20 after bad ones, and spot_scene_close_step subtracts 0x28
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecord unk_0C flags - flag word
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecord unk_10 birthday - birthday word (month bits 0-3, day bits 4-8)
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecord unk_14 scene_counters - 0x20 per-girl counters indexed by the outcome id (core spelling: scene_counters; 0x24 in the shipped record); spot_scene_close_step increments the counter of the date's outcome id; bit 0 of counters 0x13-0x18 picks the variant of the hero show and the rides (spot_ride_setup)
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecordFixed unk_00 tokimeki_fixed - 16.16 word at +0
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecordFixed unk_04 affection_fixed - 16.16 word at +4
field EVENT:SpotLegacyGirlRecordFixed unk_08 syoushin_fixed - 16.16 word at +8 (the syoushin word)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStepView pad04 mode - byte after the timer; compared with 0x50 by spot_result_talk_step
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStepView unk_00 step_timer - word at D_800B1AF0
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStepView unk_05 stage - stage byte
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStepView unk_06 step - step byte
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStepView unk_09 substep - incremented once per step by spot_result_talk_step and spot_mood_talk_step
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateFixed unk_1A4 girls - legacy girl records read as 16.16 words (second view of SpotDevelopmentState.girls)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_035 year - as in SpotDevelopmentState
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_036 month - as in SpotDevelopmentState
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_037 day - as in SpotDevelopmentState
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_106 looks - player looks value: dev +0x106 is the value halfword of the shipped param_looks record (+0x116) by the +0x10 shift of the parameter block, and the DATE twin func_8013CDF8 reads param_looks with the same thresholds; >= 0x23 (>= 0x1E except Mira) selects the first branch of spot_scene_close_step
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_1284 frame_count - shipped frame_count (+0x10F8)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_1290 step_timer - shipped step_timer (+0x1104); 0 means the first frame of the step
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_1294 mode - shipped mode (+0x1108); 0x60 is the dev girl-scene mode
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_1A4 girls - legacy girl records as 0x34-byte SpotLegacyGirlRecord
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_6CC appointment_place_0 - HYPOTHESIS: name follows core's appointment_place_0 (shipped unk_724, a core HYPOTHESIS: recent appointment places); dev +0x6CC is D_800B0F2C, which spot_place_init_step copies to spot_place as DATE func_80144720 copies unk_724 to D_800CA2F8, and spot_scene_close_step writes the date place back here as DATE func_8013CDF8 writes unk_724
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_6D5 girl_last_date_spot - per-girl date spot of the last date (12 of the 16 shipped bytes, indexed by the girl id); core: girl_last_date_spot (shipped +0x72C, dev +0x6D5 = D_800B0F35); spot_scene_close_step stores the dev outcome id D_800EECE4 here (7 as 6, 5 as 4, 0xB-0xD as 0xA) where DATE func_8013CDF8 stores its spot id D_80122D08 (8 as 7, 6 as 5); the repeat test of spot_result_talk_step compares the new outcome with it, as DATE func_8013B488 does
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStateGirls unk_EE6 current_girl - as in SpotDevelopmentState
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_014 screen_center_x - halfword per draw buffer added to polygon x in the gradient helpers; core's name for GameState +0x14 (h-graphics and h-cdio name the same field draw_origin_x because the value includes the screen shake; the merge decides, see the spec's open questions)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_018 screen_center_y - halfword per draw buffer added to polygon y in the gradient helpers; core's name for GameState +0x18 (h-graphics and h-cdio: draw_origin_y)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_035 year - compared with 0x60/0x61 (year 96/97) by the aquarium arrival; layout order year, month, day as in the shipped calendar bytes
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_036 month - compared with 3-5, 6-8, 9-11, 12/1/2 windows by spot_date_event_choose
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_037 day - paired with month in the birthday and May 4-5 tests
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_0E4 player_flags - HYPOTHESIS: dev counterpart of core's player_flags (shipped +0xF4; dev +0xE4 by the +0x10 shift of the parameter block); the special event chooser tests bit 1 of it for the Yuko winter event where the DATE twin tests ScheduleFlags bit 17 of player_flags in the same condition (dev bit numbering assumed)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_0FE athletics - athletics parameter value: dev +0xFE is the value halfword of the shipped param_athletics record (+0x10E) by the +0x10 shift of the parameter block; the DATE twin func_8013B208 (pool, skating and ski checks, below 0x28 and below 0x64) and the DATE special event chooser read param_athletics in the same five conditions; four thresholds are equal, one differs (the place 0x11 summer event needs >= 0x96 there and >= 0x64 here)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_1295 stage - shipped stage (+0x1109); read by the place frame handler
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_1296 step - shipped step (+0x110A)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_1A4 girls - 12 legacy girl records (dev layout of the shipped GameState.girls)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_5CA scene_flags - 0x4B event-seen flags set by spot_date_event_choose (shipped GameState.scene_flags at +0x56C)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_6C8 saved_game_mode - resume point saved before a girl scene: core saved_mode (shipped +0x720, dev +0x6C8); the two Miharu event triggers of spot_date_event_choose store 0x50 here and DATE stores 0x50 in unk_720 before game_mode_set(0x5E)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_6C9 saved_mode_stage - resume stage saved with saved_mode (core saved_stage, shipped +0x721); 0 in both Miharu triggers, as in DATE
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_6CA saved_mode_step - resume step saved with saved_mode (core saved_step, shipped +0x722); the dev triggers store the constant 0xC where DATE stores the current step + 1
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_6D5 girl_last_date_spot - per-girl date spot of the last date (12 of the 16 shipped bytes, indexed by the girl id); core: girl_last_date_spot (shipped +0x72C, dev +0x6D5 = D_800B0F35); spot_scene_close_step stores the dev outcome id D_800EECE4 here (7 as 6, 5 as 4, 0xB-0xD as 0xA) where DATE func_8013CDF8 stores its spot id D_80122D08 (8 as 7, 6 as 5); the repeat test of spot_result_talk_step compares the new outcome with it, as DATE func_8013B488 does
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_6E5 appointment_flag - byte tested for nonzero by spot_result_talk_step: it forces the dialogue group 0xA (0x12 for Nozomi at rank < 2) exactly as the DATE twin func_8013B488 tests core's appointment_flag (shipped +0x75C; the dev offset is +0x6E5, the byte after the 16-byte girl_last_date_spot array)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_EE6 current_girl - 152 aligned uses; shipped GameState.current_girl (+0xF5F)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentState unk_F0C pad_pressed - pad word of newly pressed buttons: the ride movie tests mask 0x400040 (the cross button on pad 1 or 2) where the DATE, DATE2 and GEKO scene steps test the shipped pad_pressed (+0xF88) with the same mask; dev offset +0xF0C
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStepViewShort unk_00 step_timer - step timer word of D_800B1AF0 (same bytes as SpotDevelopmentStepView.step_timer)
field EVENT:SpotDevelopmentStepViewShort unk_06 step - step byte of D_800B1AF0 (same byte as SpotDevelopmentStepView.step)

data RPG_BAT D_8015EC38 rpg_bg_word_0 0x8015EC38 shared background words 0..5 (EC38..EC4C): (1) wave: phase accumulator (the stage 9 wave of the delinquent encounter, wraps at twice word 2; the stage 5 ripple); (2) aliens scene: x of the background record group (records 0x2E, 0x2F and, at fixed offsets, 0x2A..0x2D; set in rpg_stage_intro_aliens, used by rpg_alien_scene_flicker)
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC3C rpg_bg_word_1 0x8015EC3C wave: amplitude (the stage 5 ripple counts it down to end the stage); aliens scene: y of the same record group (starts at -0x1E in rpg_stage_intro_aliens, whose step 9 sets it from a frame counter; in rpg_alien_departure it is 0x18 minus a counter)
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC40 rpg_bg_word_2 0x8015EC40 wave: half-cycle divisor of the phase; alien scene (rpg_alien_scene_flicker): on/off flag of background record 0x2A (cleared when its visibility bit is off, set again when switched on, 1/100 chance per frame)
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC44 rpg_bg_word_3 0x8015EC44 wave: rows per cycle; alien scene: on/off flag of background record 0x2B
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC48 rpg_bg_word_4 0x8015EC48 wave: phase step per frame; alien scene: on/off flag of background record 0x2C
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC4C rpg_bg_word_5 0x8015EC4C wave: 1 enables the stage 9 wave, which also needs the delinquent encounter flag; written 1 only by step 31 of rpg_victory_delinquents (the boss part of the finale script); aliens scene: on/off flag of background record 0x2D, cleared in rpg_stage_intro_aliens
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC50 rpg_motion 0x8015EC50 RpgMotion20 scratch: dx, dy and the six-word block rpg_move_params (D_8015EC58) as its rect member
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC58 rpg_move_params 0x8015EC58 RpgRec18 (six s32 words, 0x18 bytes; the same words are RpgMotion20.rect at D_8015EC50+8); the meaning of the words differs per use, so no field names: girl run (rpg_girl_run_set_rect, rpg_move_assist_megumi): w0/w1 home x,y (0x118, 0x88), w2/w3 target x,y (0x118 - w4, 0x60 - w5), w4/w5 per-girl effect offset x,y; basketball move (rpg_basketball_set_target_rect): w2/w3 dunk target x,y, w4/w5 a second pair per target (0x73/0x57 for the first; HYPOTHESIS: its size), w0/w1 derived points (target x + 0x30, target y - 0xB0); art move (rpg_art_step_6/7): w1, w3, w4 are two offsets and a radius, set per target

field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_00 enemy_weight_0 - weight slot 0 of the weighted enemy choosers (outcome differs per encounter); -5 when picked
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_04 enemy_weight_1 - weight slot 1 of the enemy choosers
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_08 enemy_weight_2 - weight slot 2 of the enemy choosers
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_0C enemy_weight_3 - weight slot 3 of the enemy choosers
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_10 girl_weight_wait - weight of 'no action' in rpg_girl_pick_action
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_14 girl_weight_act - weight of 'act' in rpg_girl_pick_action
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_18 result_code - alias of D_8015EC14, written back to D_80122CE0 at exit
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_1C saved_girl - alias of D_8015EC18
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_20 boss_event - alias of D_8015EC1C
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_24 pause_state - alias of D_8015EC20
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_28 pause_debounce - alias of D_8015EC24
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_2C target_x - alias of D_8015EC28
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_30 target_y - alias of D_8015EC2C
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_34 special_gauge - alias of D_8015EC30
field RPG_BAT:RpgStat unk_38 escalation_counter - alias of D_8015EC34; see rpg_escalation_counter
field RPG_BAT:RpgGauge cur hit_points - HP per delinquent slot
field RPG_BAT:RpgGauge flag charmed - charmed flag per delinquent slot
field RPG_BAT:RpgPadSeq unk_00 pad_now - pad word read this frame
field RPG_BAT:RpgPadSeq unk_04 pad_last - pad word of the previous change
field RPG_BAT:RpgPadSeq unk_08 sequence_b_progress - progress in sequence b
field RPG_BAT:RpgPadSeq unk_0C sequence_a_progress - progress in sequence a
type RPG_BAT RpgStat RpgBattleState - 0x3C battle counters block (weights, result, gauge)
type RPG_BAT RpgGauge RpgDelinquentGauges - 3 HP values and 3 charmed flags
type RPG_BAT RpgPadSeq RpgCodeEntry - button-sequence matcher state
type RPG_BAT RpgDirTable RpgSparkDirections - 8 (dx,dy) pairs
type RPG_BAT RpgHalfTbl12 RpgMenuPositions - 6 (x,y) s16 pairs
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC54 rpg_motion_dy 0x8015EC54 RPG_BAT object 0x801439E0, line(s) 114-115 writes the y displacement from end_y-start_y and uses it to interpolate actor y; shared word also feeds the girl-run and basketball motion views, keep this as the scalar address name in the interim view
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC70 rpg_move_target_actor 0x8015EC70 RPG_BAT object 0x80154430, line(s) 110-131 chooses actor record 0x3B, 0x3C, or 0x3D and the hide/show loop indexes actor_pool with it; RPG_BAT/801484E0.c also indexes the target table through this base
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC78 rpg_move_timer 0x8015EC78 RPG_BAT object 0x80136530, line(s) 78-92 increments and bounds it as a move counter; RPG_BAT object 0x80157AE0, line(s) 439-446 derives a positive frame wait before calling rpg_enemy_wait_substep; generic role because other move scripts reuse it
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC7C rpg_move_value_0 0x8015EC7C RPG_BAT object 0x80151C10, line(s) 14-72 uses as one animated coordinate; RPG_BAT object 0x80134D30, line(s) 62-71 uses as the starting x coordinate of a linear interpolation. Reused parameter meaning varies by move.
data RPG_BAT D_8015EC80 rpg_move_value_1 0x8015EC80 RPG_BAT object 0x80134D30, line(s) 63,204-205 uses as the ending x coordinate of the same interpolation; RPG_BAT object 0x80154430, line(s) 258 clears it; reused scratch value.
data RPG_BAT D_8015ECB8 rpg_move_x_start 0x8015ECB8 RPG_BAT object 0x80134D30, line(s) 109-110,209 is the per-club start x coordinate in the two-point interpolation

field TACO:TcActor unk0 flag_bytes - u8[2]: byte 1 is the flag byte (0x80 active and shootable, 0x40 contact damage only, 0x10 dying), byte 0 unused; propose splitting into pad0 and flags
field TACO:TcActor unk2 mode - player: roll and state bits (1 roll left, 2 roll right, 4 hit flash, 0x40 bomb running, 0x80 invulnerable); enemy: behavior id; boss controllers: step or key index
field TACO:TcActor unk3 phase - player: roll speed counter; enemy: 1 alive, 2 dying; boss controllers: pace counter
field TACO:TcActor unk4 model - object handle (GsDOBJ2)
field TACO:TcActor unk14 coordinate - coordinate object (GsCOORDINATE2)
field TACO:TcActor unk64 rotation_x - rotation about x, 4096 per turn
field TACO:TcActor unk66 rotation_y - rotation about y
field TACO:TcActor unk68 rotation_z - rotation about z (the player roll angle)
field TACO:TcActor unk6A param - spawn parameter (spin axis, formation index, ring angle)
field TACO:TcActor unk6C scale_x - model scale (0x1000 is 1.0), player 0x400
field TACO:TcActor unk6E scale_y - scale
field TACO:TcActor unk70 scale_z - scale
field TACO:TcActor unk72 weapon - primary weapon: -1 vulcan, 0 wide shot, 1 beam
field TACO:TcActor unk74 x - world x; positive is screen left (pad left increases it)
field TACO:TcActor unk76 y - world y; positive is down
field TACO:TcActor unk78 z - world z; the player is near 0x800, enemies come from -0x8000
field TACO:TcActor unk7A counter - multi-use 16-bit counter: enemy: frames since spawn (0x7FFF marks a fresh spawn); player: hit timer; boss part: number of HP bars (set when the part is attached; shooter_boss_damage_percent multiplies each part's table HP by it and unk82 counts bars used against it)
field TACO:TcActor unk7C argument_x - player: bomb slot 1; enemy: spawn argument x (path centre, speed, phase)
field TACO:TcActor unk7E argument_y - player: bomb slot 2; enemy: spawn argument y
field TACO:TcActor unk80 argument_z - player: bomb slot 3; enemy: spawn argument z
field TACO:TcActor unk82 auxiliary - player: secondary weapon (0 homing, 1 spread, -1 start); boss part: bars used (compared against unk7A, the bar count); enemy: key or pose index
field TACO:TcActor unk84 stats - u8[4]: radius (units of 16), HP, kind (enemy type or class), hit flags (bit0 hittable, high nibble drop code)
field TACO:Tc14 unk0 x - world position
field TACO:Tc14 unk2 y - world position
field TACO:Tc14 unk4 z - world position
field TACO:Tc14 unk6 w - spare; element 0 of the spark and explosion tables holds the ring index
field TACO:Tc14 unk8 velocity_x - velocity
field TACO:Tc14 unkA velocity_y - velocity
field TACO:Tc14 unkC velocity_z - velocity
field TACO:Tc14 unk11 argument - shot: homing target slot; item: kind; bullet: flags; spark: image index
field TACO:Tc14 unk12 age - frames alive (255 ends)
field TACO:Tc14 unk13 flags - 0x80 active, 0x20 beam, 0x10 player-side, low nibble kind
field TACO:TacoParticle14 unk_00 position - ShooterPosition
field TACO:TacoParticle14 unk_08 velocity - ShooterPosition
field TACO:TacoParticle14 unk_11 image_index - image index
field TACO:TacoParticle14 unk_12 age - frame counter of the current image
field TACO:TacoParticle14 unk_13 flags - 0x80 active
field TACO:TcPos unk6 w - fourth halfword: ring index, spin selector or spare
field TACO:Tc10 unk0 attribute - library attribute word: 0x80000000 hides the object, 0x40000000 is used to blink out dead boss parts, 0 shows it
field TACO:Tc10 unk4 links - three words: coordinate object, model, id
field TACO:TcObj50 unk0 flag - 0 marks the local matrix as changed
field TACO:TcObj50 unk4 rotation - 3x3 rotation, s16
field TACO:TcObj50 unk18 x - local translation x
field TACO:TcObj50 unk1C y - local translation y
field TACO:TcObj50 unk20 z - local translation z
field TACO:TcObj50 unk24 world - world matrix computed by the library
field TACO:TcObj50 unk44 param - library parameter word
field TACO:TcObj50 unk48 parent - super link
field TACO:TcObj50 unk4C child - sub link
field TACO:TacoCam a x - horizontal offset of the floor grid
field TACO:TacoCam b y - height of the floor plane (0x400)
field TACO:TacoCam c scroll_z - scroll phase, +0x80 per frame, wraps at 0x1000
field TACO:TacoCam d tile_phase - counts wraps; selects the tile image
field TACO:TacoRnd a angle - star angle, 4096 per turn
field TACO:TacoRnd b radius - star distance times 1000
field TACO:TacoDigits s characters - template characters
field TACO:TcDirections28 pos vectors - five pairs
field TACO:TcRotations14 rotation spins - five values
field TACO:TcDamage9 bytes by_kind - damage per shot kind 0-8
field TACO:TcPair8 a translation - pointer to the translation rows
field TACO:TcPair8 b rotation - pointer to the rotation rows
field TACO:TcPair2 a translation_fixed - flag byte
field TACO:TcPair2 b rotation_fixed - flag byte
field TACO:TcTransformObj50 unk_00 flag - same as ShooterCoordinate flag
field TACO:TcTransformObj50 transform local - local matrix
type TACO TcPos ShooterPosition - four s16 (x, y, z, w); position, velocity or spawn argument
type TACO Tc10 ShooterModelHandle - GsDOBJ2 object handle (attribute word, links)
type TACO TcObj50 ShooterCoordinate - GsCOORDINATE2 coordinate object (0x50 bytes)
type TACO TcActor ShooterActor - 0x88-byte actor: ship, wingman, enemy or boss part; 79 records
type TACO Tc14 ShooterParticle - 0x14-byte world-space record for shots, bullets, items, sparks and explosions; scalar fields include position, velocity_x/y/z, argument, age and flags. The unused word and byte remain unnamed; ShooterParticleView is a second view.
type TACO TacoParticle14 ShooterParticleView - overlay view of the same 0x14-byte particle records: two ShooterPosition values plus four bytes; kept separate from ShooterParticle because it has distinct position, velocity and image-index use.
type TACO TacoRnd ShooterStar - star of the 100-star field (angle, radius)
type TACO TacoCam ShooterBackgroundScroll - scroll state of the floor grid
type TACO TcTex4 ShooterTextureCoordinates - four texture coordinate bytes
type TACO TacoDigits ShooterScoreTemplate - 11-byte template copied by the score formatter
type TACO TcTransformObj50 ShooterCoordinateView - word view of ShooterCoordinate with the local matrix
type TACO TcDirection ShooterPlanarVelocity - pair of s32 (x, y)
type TACO TcDirections28 ShooterFormationVelocities - five velocity pairs of the formation fan
type TACO TcRotations14 ShooterFormationSpins - five spin speeds
type TACO TcDamage9 ShooterShotDamage - damage per shot kind, 9 bytes
type TACO TcPair8 ShooterPosePointers - pair of words: translation and rotation base pointers
type TACO TcPair2 ShooterPoseFlags - pair of bytes: fixed flags of a pose pair
type TACO TacoLightBlock ShooterLightBlock - three libgs light entries of 16 bytes
type TACO TcSave ShooterSettingsBlock - overlay-only union view of D_800E7D10+0x40: flag word, scores, names. Core owns its own SaveTacoSettings declaration; this row does not rename or replace it.
type TACO TcSetW ShooterSettingsWordView - overlay-only word view of settings mode and selector bytes. Core owns its separate TacoSettingsBits declaration; this row does not rename or replace it.
type TACO TcSetH ShooterSettingsHalfView - overlay-only halfword view of the shot selector.
type TACO TcSetB ShooterSettingsByteView - overlay-only byte view with the bomb selector.
type TACO TcSetF ShooterSettingsFlagView - overlay-only bit view of the saved flag.
type TACO TcBits ShooterUnlockBits - overlay-only view of the two TACO settings bits: pad and return-to-caller flag.
func TT func_80132000 tt_animation_list_step 0x80132000 HYPOTHESIS: steps a list animator: 3-byte entries (hold count, tile code, palette); 0xFE terminator sets the done bit; callers: ground targets, enemy shots, pickups (bell family (HYPOTHESIS name, spec 6.4))
func TT func_801320F0 tt_angle_between 0x801320F0 ratan2 of the 16.16 position difference (+0x10/+0xC) shifted down 16; used by boss aimed attacks and air waves
func TT func_80132130 tt_ranking_heading_init 0x80132130 fills sprite record 0 with the heading banner (x -0x38, y 0x48, 0x70x0x10 source rect)
func TT func_80132198 tt_ranking_rows_init 0x80132198 fills the three ranking rows (rank label, time text 0x28+i, name text 0x2B+i) with the colours given as arguments; reads the table at sys+0x30
func TT func_8013230C tt_ranking_panel_init 0x8013230C inits the 5x5 tile grid, the frame panel sprites and the three background tints (arg 12, 13 or 14 picks core+0x13..0x15)
func TT func_80132810 tt_ranking_grid_scroll 0x80132810 scrolls the 25 background grid tiles diagonally; offset wraps at 0x48

field TT:TtEnemyShot unk_3C flip - flip mode 0..3 written from byte 2 of the frame list entry (0xFF keeps the old value)
field TT:TtEnemyShot unk_3D animation_set - sprite set index of a sprite set animation (kind 0xAB)
field TT:TtEnemyShot unk_3E animation_frame - frame list index of the list animator; sprite frame for kind 0xAB
field TT:TtEnemyShot unk_40 animation_flags - bit 0 set when the frame list reached its terminator
field TT:TtEnemyShot unk_41 animation_hold - hold counter of the list animator; kind 0xAB uses it as age (frame = age/12 + 0xF, capped at 0x30)
field TT:TtEnemyShot unk_4C hitbox - pointer to the TtHitbox used against the player and shots
field TT:TtEnemyShot unk_58 homing_age - kind 0xAC: frames of homing so far (stops at 0x100); beam: age
field TT:TtEnemyShot unk_60 heading - kind 0xAC heading angle (0x800 offset); kind 0xAD: x the beam follows
field TT:TtEnemyShot unk_62 beam_length - kind 0xAD current beam length (grows by 4 to 0x20)

field TT:TtCore unk_00 state - core state 0..8, index into tt_state_table
field TT:TtCore unk_02 sub_state - state specific step (0 init, 0x20 fade in, 0x40 run, 0x80 fade out)
field TT:TtCore unk_04 sub_step - second step counter, cleared on a state change
field TT:TtCore unk_06 phase - cleared on a state change
field TT:TtCore unk_09 request_next - 1 = the state asks for its follow-up state (chosen by the handler)
field TT:TtCore unk_0A flag_a - state specific flag
field TT:TtCore unk_0B flag_b - state specific flag
field TT:TtCore unk_11 pause_allowed - 1 while the START pause works
field TT:TtCore unk_1C bg_mode - background renderer selector, see TtBgMode
field TT:TtCore unk_1D fade_r - colour scale of the fade, 0x80 = normal
field TT:TtCore unk_1E fade_g - colour scale of the fade
field TT:TtCore unk_1F fade_b - colour scale of the fade
field TT:TtCore unk_22 autoplay - 1 = replay recorded input (attract demo or exhibit)
field TT:TtCore unk_26 timer - state timer in frames
field TT:TtCore unk_2E fade_level - 0x80 down to 0 while fading in
field TT:TtStageScript pad0 progress_frac - fraction half of the 16.16 progress
field TT:TtStageScript time progress - integer half of the progress, the clock of the scripts
field TT:TtStageScript cmd air_script_cursor - next 6-byte air script command
field TT:TtSysView unk_56 se_flags - 64 per-frame sound dedupe flags
field TT:TtPartAnimation frames sets - pointer to the sprite set table
field TT:TtPartAnimation unk_04 flip - bit 0 flips y, bit 1 flips x
field TT:TtPartAnimation unk_05 set - sprite set index
field TT:TtPartAnimation unk_06 frame - frame index inside the set
field TT:TtPartAnimation unk_08 flags - 0x80 restart, 0x20 re-arm, 0x40 pause, bit 0 done
field TT:TtPartAnimation unk_09 hold - frames left on the current frame
field TT:TtPartAnimation unk_0B clut - palette byte
field TT:TtPartAnimation unk_10 transform_enable - 1 = apply the transform record
field TT:TtSprAnim clutOverride clut_override - nonzero = use clut instead of the part palette
field TT:TtSprAnim unk_10 transform_enable - 1 = apply the transform record
field TT:TtRankingEntry unk_00 time - best time in frames (1/60 s)
field TT:TtRankingEntry unk_02 name - 3 glyph codes and a terminator
field TT:TtConfigBits b0 bomb_button - button code of the bomb
field TT:TtConfigBits b8 autofire - auto-fire option
field TT:TtConfigBits b9 narrow_display - func_8013E6A0 selects 256-pixel display windows when this saved flag is nonzero and 320 when zero; fixed-width bit field retained
field TT:TtConfigBits b25 direct_mode - 1 = start in the stage given by stage_select without the title
field TT:TtConfigBits b26 stage_select - stage 1..4 for the direct mode (3 bits)
field TT:TtConfigBits b29 use_pad2 - 1 = read pad 2 as player input
field TT:TtHitbox w half_w - half width
field TT:TtHitbox h half_h - half height
field TT:TtPadView unk_04 pressed - buttons newly pressed this frame
field TT:TtSprAnim unk_07 reserved - three unused bytes
field TT:TtAnimFrame unk0 tile - u16 tile code
field TT:TtAnimFrame unk2 hold - frames to show the frame
field TT:TtAnimFrame unk3 loop_back - 0 continue, 0xFF end, else frames to jump back
field TT:TtText unk_00 active - 0 = free
field TT:TtText unk_01 limited - 1 = draw only count glyphs
field TT:TtText unk_02 palette - palette index 0..15
field TT:TtText ot layer - ordering table index
field TT:TtObjectView unk_00 active - 0 = free slot
field TT:TtObjectView unk_10 layer - ordering table index
field TT:TtObjectView unk_14 x - screen x
field TT:TtObjectView unk_16 y - screen y
field TT:TtObjectView unk_20 position_x - 16.16 position
field TT:TtObjectView unk_24 position_y - 16.16 position
field TT:TtObjectView unk_02 kind - air enemy kind (same word as TtFieldEnemy.kind)
field TT:TtObjectView unk_04 state - state word (same as TtFieldEnemy.state)
field TT:TtObjectView unk_06 phase - reset together with step, step2 and the ticks when the state changes
field TT:TtObjectView unk_08 step - see phase
field TT:TtObjectView unk_0A step2 - see phase
field TT:TtObjectView unk_0D tick0 - byte counter reset with the state
field TT:TtObjectView unk_0E tick1 - byte counter reset with the state
field TT:TtObjectView unk_0F tick2 - byte counter reset with the state
field TT:TtCoreWarpView unk_32 warp_phase - wave phase of the warped tile map (background modes 0x10 and 0x11); +1 per frame, used as sine argument (x 32 plus 0x200 per mesh row or column)
field TT:TtCoreWarpView unk_34 warp_divisor - divisor of the wave in the warp mesh and of the mesh spacing: 0x1000 = flat, mode 0x10 lowers it by 0x20 to 0x100 (stronger warp), mode 0x11 raises it by 0x40 to 0x1000 and then returns to background mode 2
field TT:TtCoreGridView offset scroll_offset - u16 scroll offset of the ranking screen grid (0..0x47, +1 per frame); shares the word at +0x2E with TtCore.fade_level
field TT:TtPartAnimationView unk_00 sets - pointer to the sprite set table (tt_sprite_set_table)
field TT:TtPartAnimationView unk_04 flip - bit 0 flips y, bit 1 flips x
field TT:TtPartAnimationView unk_05 set - sprite set index
field TT:TtPartAnimationView unk_08 flags - 0x80 restart, 0x20 re-arm, 0x40 pause, bit 0 done
field TT:TtPartAnimationView unk_10 transform_enable - 1 = apply the transform record
field TT:TtAnimationView unk_05 set - sprite set index
field TT:TtAnimationView unk_06 frame - frame index inside the set
field TT:TtAnimationView unk_08 flags - 0x80 restart, 0x20 re-arm, 0x40 pause, bit 0 done
field TT:TtAnimationView unk_09 hold - frames left on the current frame

local ETC:exam_score_day main primary_score - Main parameter contribution in each weekday's exam score calculation.
local ETC:exam_score_day bio biorhythm_score - Biorhythm contribution returned by the shared biorhythm helper.
local ETC:exam_score_day score week_total_score - Accumulated score after adding the current day score to slot 5.
local ETC:exam_score_day w exam_work - Pointer to the overlay's 0x40-byte exam working record.
local ETC:exam_score_day g state - Pointer to the shared GameState.
local ETC:career_choice_exam_question var_a1 answer_wrong - One means this answer failed its selected threshold; it also selects the wrong-answer animation sequence.
local ETC:career_choice_exam_question var_v0 club_bonus - Practice points shifted right four and capped at 20 before adding to the subject parameter.
local ETC:career_choice_exam_question var_v1 subject_score - Subject parameter after the club bonus and health penalty, compared with the selected threshold.
param ETC:album_event_picture_select arg0 category - Event-log category selects the portrait or animation branch.
param ETC:album_event_picture_select arg1 scene - Scene id selects the resource mapping within the category.
param ETC:album_event_picture_select arg2 girl - Girl id selects girl-specific portrait resources.
param ETC:album_event_picture_select arg3 season - Season selects the seasonal portrait table.
local ETC:career_guidance_closest_girl var_s0 girl_index - Index used while scanning girls for the highest qualifying closeness.
local ETC:career_guidance_closest_girl var_s7 selected_girl - Girl id that passes the selection checks and has the best closeness.
local ETC:career_guidance_closest_girl var_s2 best_closeness - Highest qualifying girl score retained during the scan.
